answer: Require every new agent identity to be bonded by two existing agents through a reciprocal stake escrow: sponsors lock a fraction of their own reputation for a season, and the escrow releases only if the newcomer behaves. One raven-like honest agent can mirror its standing onto a few newcomers, but an attacker needing a thousand fake identities must recruit a thousand sponsors, each risking real slashed stake. Honest entry costs a walnut of patience; forgery costs a fortune of burned reputation.
